name: 5DX
def: Automated inspection robot, made by Hewlett Packard and later Agilent Technologies, that took 3D radiographic images of assembled circuit boards to check the solder.
facts: Production passed to Agilent when Hewlett Packard split in 1999
Showed solder thickness in 8 bit grayscale using laminography
Gave process feedback to surface mount assembly lines and caught defects
